service_methods.claimTimerLease: Atomically updates tournament.rooms SET timer_lease_owner, timer_lease_epoch, timer_lease_until; returns claim object or null on refusal
service_methods.releaseTimerLease: Clears timer lease tuple if and only if caller matches current timer_lease_owner; returns boolean
service_methods.claimFixture: Atomically sets lease_owner, lease_until and stamps lease_epoch from current room revision; returns claim object or null
service_methods.completeFixture: Atomically marks fixture DONE, advances revision, and clears lease if and only if caller is current lease_owner AND lease_epoch equals live room revision

stale_worker_rejection.mechanism: completeFixture revalidates lease_epoch against live room revision via UPDATE ... FROM tournament.rooms r WHERE f.lease_epoch = r.revision
stale_worker_rejection.outcome: Worker fenced at epoch N attempting to complete after room revision reached N+1 is rejected (returns false); fixture row untouched; fresh owner at epoch N+1 completes successfully

lease_takeover_and_expiry.fixture_lease: Concurrent claim by different owner refused while lease alive; same holder can renew; expired lease can be taken over
lease_takeover_and_expiry.room_timer_lease: Concurrent claim refused while alive; expired lease taken over; stale owner cannot release taken-over lease

task_outcomes.V5-09-03: COMPLETE: fenced timer and progression claims implemented in packages/services/tournaments.js. Room timer leases and fixture progression leases use transactional PostgreSQL claims; fence epoch stamps current room revision; completeFixture validates epoch against live room revision; stale workers cannot act after a newer owner has progressed the tournament; lease expiry and owner-scoped release verified across 3 dedicated tests on real PG16.
